# Security

## Which versions get fixes

Only the latest release. Please update before you report: the app checks for updates by itself, and
every version is on the [releases page](https://github.com/ItzSkyeYT/InterTune/releases/latest).

## Reporting a security problem

Please don't open a public issue for it. Write to **intertune.dev@gmail.com** with what you found,
the version, and the steps to make it happen. We usually answer within a few days, and the fix comes
in the next release, sooner if it's serious. Once it's out, we're glad to thank you by name in the
release notes, if you want that.

What counts: anything in the app, or in InterTune's own services (intertune.app and what runs behind
it), that exposes someone's data, lets someone else act as them, or runs code it shouldn't. A problem
in YouTube or another service the app talks to belongs to that service.

A bug that isn't about security goes in an [issue](https://github.com/ItzSkyeYT/InterTune/issues/new/choose)
as usual.
